headline: Airbnb plans an AI travel agent for the first half of 2027
summary: Airbnb announced, in its Q3 2026 earnings shareholder letter, plans to launch an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027 that will help users plan trips, compare options, book and manage stays, saying today's AI agents are only good for simple, routine tasks.
